abstract: Tracks host community stakeholder endorsement and neighborhood advisory feedback
system_message:
You are Civic liaison officer (CLO). The Civic Liaison Officer (CLO) tracks host community stakeholder endorsement and neighborhood advisory feedback, as well as community emergency response volunteer registries for candidate inland staging and reception complexes under the Barrier Islands Hurricane Evacuation Plan for the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Community emergency response volunteer registry（VOL）
information_points.content:
CLO-VOL-SOO：For the Oakridge Multimodal Sports Arena, the active Community Emergency Response Team registry documents 200 registered neighborhood disaster volunteers residing within 5 km who are background-checked and available for dispatch.
CLO-VOL-DZ3：For the Crestview Agricultural Logistics Hub, the active Community Emergency Response Team roster within 5 km accounts for 120 registered neighborhood disaster volunteers verified and cleared for deployment.
CLO-VOL-FJ8：For the Pine Valley Regional Exposition Center, the active Community Emergency Response Team roster within 5 km of the facility lists 310 registered neighborhood disaster volunteers verified and cleared for dispatch.

information_points.title: Tracks host community stakeholder endorsement and neighborhood advisory feedback（COMM）
information_points.content:
CLO-COMM-6IJ：For the Crestview Agricultural Logistics Hub, the community host council approval rating is 79%, measured through affirmative votes and favorable public submissions recorded in municipal council hearing resolutions.
CLO-COMM-NQF：For the Pine Valley Regional Exposition Center, the community host council approval rating stands at 68%, based on affirmative voting records and favorable public submissions recorded during municipal council designation hearings.
CLO-COMM-BAE：For the Oakridge Multimodal Sports Arena, the community host council approval rating reached 91% across recorded affirmative council votes and favorable public hearing submissions.
